# Scriptling

> Scriptling is a sandbox-safe, Python-like scripting language for Go applications: embed the interpreter, register only the libraries your host allows, and generate normal Python 3 style code.

Docs: https://scriptling.dev/docs/

All 183 OKF 0.2 concepts below are plain markdown served from https://scriptling.dev/okf/. Links here and inside every document are absolute URLs: fetch any of them directly.

## Essential

- [LLM Script Generation Guide](https://scriptling.dev/docs/llm-guide/): Guidance for generating Scriptling code — includes a copyable AGENTS.md block
- [Quick Start](https://scriptling.dev/docs/quick-start/): Install the CLI or embed in Go
- [Command Line Options](https://scriptling.dev/docs/cli/command-line-options/): Every flag, environment variable, and config file setting
- [Security Guide](https://scriptling.dev/docs/security/): Sandboxing, filesystem restrictions, and network policies
- [Documentation MCP Server](https://scriptling.dev/docs/quick-start/documentation-mcp/): Serve the docs to agents over MCP with search

## OKF bundles

Fetchable markdown (OKF 0.2) — each bundle's index.md lists its concepts:

- [scriptling-docs](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-docs/index.md): Guides: quick start, CLI usage, Go integration, plugins, security, and tutorials.
- [scriptling-reference](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/index.md): Language reference: syntax, types, operators, control flow, functions, classes, and error handling.
- [scriptling-libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/index.md): API reference for every standard, Scriptling, and extended library.
- [OKF catalog](https://scriptling.dev/okf/index.md): Markdown index of all bundles

## scriptling-reference

> Language reference: syntax, types, operators, control flow, functions, classes, and error handling.

- [Built-in Functions](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/builtins.md): Type conversions, math, string, list, and dictionary built-in functions in Scriptling.
- [Classes](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/classes.md): Class definition, inheritance, super(), dunder methods, __init__, __del__, and property decorators in Scriptling.
- [Control Flow](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/control-flow.md): Conditionals, loops, match statements, break, continue, and pass in Scriptling.
- [Decorators](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/decorators.md): Using decorators to wrap functions and classes, decorator factories with arguments, stacking, and built-in decorators in Scriptling.
- [Error Handling](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/error-handling.md): try/except/else/finally, raise, assert, and exception types in Scriptling.
- [Functions](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/functions.md): Function definition, parameters, *args, **kwargs, lambdas, and closures in Scriptling.
- [Operators](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/operators.md): Arithmetic, comparison, boolean, bitwise operators and precedence in Scriptling.
- [Performance Guide](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/performance.md): Tips and best practices for writing efficient Scriptling code.
- [Python Differences](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/python-differences.md): What's NOT supported and key differences between Scriptling and Python.
- [Language Guide](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/scriptling-reference.md): Reference for the Scriptling language - syntax, data types, operators, control flow, functions, classes, and built-in functions.
- [Indexing & Slicing](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/slicing.md): Single index access, slice notation, and the slice() builtin in Scriptling.
- [Syntax Rules](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/syntax.md): Indentation, comments, case sensitivity, and multiline syntax in Scriptling.
- [Data Types](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-reference/types.md): Integers, floats, strings, booleans, lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples in Scriptling.

## scriptling-libraries

> API reference for every standard, Scriptling, and extended library.

- [scriptling.ai.agent](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/agent.md): Agentic AI loop for building AI agents with automatic tool execution.
- [scriptling.ai](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/ai.md): AI and LLM functions for OpenAI-compatible APIs: clients, completions, embeddings, and tool-calling helpers.
- [scriptling.ai.Client](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/client.md): Primary client interface for calling AI providers like OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini.
- [scriptling.ai.agent.interact](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/interact.md): Interactive terminal interface for conversing with AI agents via a REPL-style loop.
- [scriptling.ai.memory](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/memory.md): Long-term, deduplicated memory store for AI agents backed by a KV store.
- [scriptling.ai.tools](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai/tools.md): Tool schema builder for AI agents.
- [AI](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/ai.md): AI integration libraries for building intelligent agents.
- [Library Cheat Sheet](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/cheat-sheet.md): Quick reference for common Scriptling library patterns.
- [collections](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/collections-iteration/collections.md): Specialized container datatypes, counters, double-ended queues, named tuples, and chained dicts.
- [contextlib](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/collections-iteration/contextlib.md): Utilities for common tasks involving the with statement.
- [functools](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/collections-iteration/functools.md): Higher-order functions that act on or return other functions.
- [itertools](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/collections-iteration/itertools.md): Iteration utilities for efficient looping, filtering, and combinatorics.
- [Collections & Iteration](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/collections-iteration.md): Container datatypes, iterators, and functional programming tools.
- [bytes](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats/bytes.md): Binary data type and constructor.
- [json](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats/json.md): Parse and generate JSON data.
- [msgpack](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats/msgpack.md): Parse and generate MessagePack binary data.
- [toml](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats/toml.md): Parse and generate TOML (Tom's Obvious Minimal Language) data.
- [yaml](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats/yaml.md): Parse and generate YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language) data.
- [Data Formats](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/data-formats.md): Libraries for parsing and generating structured data formats.
- [scriptling.badgerdb](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases/badgerdb.md): BadgerDB embedded key/value store with the valkey API on local storage.
- [Relational ORM](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases/orm.md): conn.get_orm() gives queries, builders, criteria and model gateways for every relational backend.
- [scriptling.sql](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases/sql.md): MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL client with one connect() per DSN scheme and one shared API.
- [scriptling.sqlite](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases/sqlite.md): SQLite embedded relational database, connect, query, execute, close.
- [scriptling.valkey](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases/valkey.md): Valkey and Redis key/value client with strings, counters, TTLs, sets, queues and key patterns.
- [Database Libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/databases.md): SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL, Valkey/Redis and BadgerDB plugins, two API shapes, four backends.
- [fs](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/fs.md): Binary I/O for reading, writing, and unpacking binary file formats.
- [glob](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/glob.md): Unix shell-style wildcard matching for filenames, similar to Python's glob module.
- [os](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/os.md): Operating system interfaces for file system operations and environment variables.
- [os.path](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/os.path.md): Common pathname manipulations, similar to Python's os.path module.
- [pathlib](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/pathlib.md): Object-oriented filesystem paths, similar to Python's pathlib module.
- [shutil](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/shutil.md): High-level file and directory operations — copy, move, rmtree, disk_usage.
- [tarfile](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/tarfile.md): Read and write TAR archives (uncompressed and gzipped).
- [tempfile](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/tempfile.md): Temporary file and directory creation with security restrictions.
- [zipfile](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem/zipfile.md): Read and write ZIP archives.
- [File System](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/filesystem.md): File and directory access libraries. All require registration when embedding.
- [logging](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process/logging.md): Python-style logging, backed by structured slog-based loggers.
- [requests](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process/requests.md): HTTP client for making GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH requests.
- [secrets](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process/secrets.md): Cryptographically strong random number generation for tokens, keys, and passwords.
- [subprocess](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process/subprocess.md): Spawn and manage subprocesses, similar to Python's subprocess module.
- [sys](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process/sys.md): System-specific parameters and functions, similar to Python's sys module.
- [HTTP & Process](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/http-process.md): HTTP client, subprocess management, and system libraries. All require registration when embedding.
- [base64](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/base64.md): Base64 encoding and decoding.
- [hashlib](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/hashlib.md): Cryptographic hash functions.
- [hmac](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/hmac.md): Keyed-hashing for message authentication (HMAC).
- [math](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/math.md): Mathematical functions and constants.
- [random](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/random.md): Random number generation, compatible with Python's random module.
- [statistics](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/statistics.md): Functions for calculating mathematical statistics of numeric data.
- [uuid](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers/uuid.md): UUID generation, matching Python's uuid module.
- [Math & Numbers](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/math-numbers.md): Mathematical functions, hashing, and random number generation.
- [scriptling.mcp](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/mcp/client.md): MCP client library for connecting to MCP servers and invoking the tools they expose.
- [scriptling.mcp.tool](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/mcp/tool.md): MCP tool helper for authoring MCP tools, with parameter access and result handling.
- [Writing MCP Tools](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/mcp/writing-mcp-tools.md): Creating custom MCP tools with metadata and script files.
- [MCP Protocol](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/mcp.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) client and tool authoring libraries.
- [scriptling.messaging.console](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/messaging/console.md): Console-based messaging client for building and testing interactive terminal bots.
- [scriptling.messaging.discord](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/messaging/discord.md): Discord Bot API client using a WebSocket Gateway connection for real-time events.
- [scriptling.messaging.slack](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/messaging/slack.md): Slack Bot API client using Socket Mode for real-time events.
- [scriptling.messaging.telegram](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/messaging/telegram.md): Telegram Bot API client for building bots on the Telegram platform.
- [Messaging](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/messaging.md): Platform-agnostic bot framework for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and Console.
- [scriptling.net.gossip](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking/gossip.md): Gossip protocol cluster membership and messaging with failure detection and routing.
- [scriptling.net.multicast](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking/multicast.md): UDP multicast group messaging for one-to-many communication on local networks.
- [scriptling.net.resolve](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking/resolve.md): DNS resolution for hostname lookup, SRV records, and srv+http(s):// URLs.
- [scriptling.net.unicast](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking/unicast.md): UDP and TCP point-to-point messaging for direct host-to-host communication.
- [scriptling.net.websocket](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking/websocket.md): WebSocket client for sending and receiving text or binary messages.
- [Networking Libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/networking.md): Networking libraries for cluster membership, multicast, point-to-point messaging, and WebSocket communication.
- [scriptling.package](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/package.md): Read metadata and files from app and plugin bundles loaded by the host.
- [scriptling.plugin](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/plugin.md): Control library for listing, inspecting, calling, and loading executable plugins at runtime.
- [scriptling.provision.fetch](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/provisioning/provision-fetch.md): Download files over HTTP/HTTPS and optionally unpack zip archives, idempotently.
- [scriptling.provision.file](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/provisioning/provision-file.md): Create, update, and remove files and directories idempotently, including marker-delimited managed blocks.
- [Provisioning Libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/provisioning.md): File and directory provisioning libraries for Scriptling.
- [scriptling.runtime.http](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/http.md): Register HTTP routes, middleware, and response helpers for a Scriptling-backed server.
- [scriptling.runtime.jsonrpc](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/jsonrpc.md): Register JSON-RPC 2.0 server methods and notifications served over stdio or HTTP.
- [scriptling.runtime.kv](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/kv.md): Thread-safe key-value store for sharing state across requests and background tasks.
- [scriptling.runtime.mcp](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/mcp.md): Register MCP tools via decorators — metadata and implementation in a single file.
- [scriptling.runtime.plugin](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/plugin.md): Declare a Scriptling script as a first-class plugin server exposing functions, constants, and classes to remote clients.
- [scriptling.runtime](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/runtime.md): Background tasks and concurrency, plus the runtime namespace grouping HTTP, JSON-RPC, KV, MCP, sync, sandbox, and plugin sub-libraries.
- [scriptling.runtime.sandbox](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/sandbox.md): Create isolated Scriptling execution environments for running script code with its own variable scope.
- [scriptling.runtime.sync](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime/sync.md): Named cross-environment concurrency primitives, atomics, shared variables, wait groups, and queues.
- [Runtime](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/runtime.md): Runtime utilities for background tasks, HTTP servers, key-value storage, concurrency, and plugin server support.
- [Libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/scriptling-libraries.md): Available libraries and APIs in Scriptling.
- [scriptling.template.html](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/template/html.md): HTML template rendering using Go's html/template, with automatic escaping.
- [scriptling.template.text](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/template/text.md): Text template rendering using Go's text/template, with no escaping.
- [scriptling.template](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/template.md): Go-powered text and HTML template rendering with automatic escaping.
- [difflib](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/difflib.md): Compute deltas between sequences, including unified diffs, similarity ratios, and close-match finding.
- [html](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/html.md): Escape and unescape HTML special characters and entities.
- [html.parser](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/html.parser.md): An HTML/XHTML parser compatible with Python's html.parser module.
- [regex](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/regex.md): Regular expression matching and text processing, following Python's re module conventions.
- [shlex](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/shlex.md): Shell-style lexical analysis — quoting, splitting, and joining command-line tokens.
- [string](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/string.md): String constants for character classification, matching Python's string module.
- [textwrap](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing/textwrap.md): Text wrapping and filling utilities, compatible with Python's textwrap module.
- [Text Processing](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/text-processing.md): Libraries for working with text, strings, and markup.
- [datetime](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system/datetime.md): Date and time objects with construction, formatting, arithmetic, and comparison, using a Python-compatible API.
- [io](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system/io.md): In-memory text I/O streams, providing StringIO as a buffer that behaves like a text file.
- [platform](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system/platform.md): Read-only access to the underlying operating system, architecture, and hostname information.
- [time](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system/time.md): Time access and conversions, including timestamps, time tuples, formatting, and sleeping.
- [urllib.parse](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system/urllib.md): Parse, split, join, and percent-encode/decode URLs and query strings without network access.
- [Time & System](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/time-system.md): Time access, I/O streams, and platform information.
- [scriptling.console](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/console.md): TUI (terminal UI) console for building interactive chat-style applications.
- [scriptling.container](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/container.md): Container lifecycle management for Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers through a unified interface.
- [scriptling.csv](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/csv.md): CSV parsing and formatting (string-based, no filesystem access).
- [scriptling.find](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/find.md): Find files and directories by name, type, modification time, and size.
- [scriptling.grep](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/grep.md): Fast file content search using regular expressions or literal strings.
- [scriptling.markdown](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/markdown.md): Convert Markdown to HTML using the GitHub Flavored Markdown specification.
- [scriptling.nomad](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/nomad.md): HashiCorp Nomad client covering CSI volumes, dynamic host volumes, and jobs.
- [scriptling.secret](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/secret.md): Resolve secrets through host-configured provider aliases without exposing provider credentials to scripts.
- [scriptling.sed](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/sed.md): In-place file content replacement and capture group extraction.
- [scriptling.similarity](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/similarity.md): Text similarity utilities for fuzzy matching, tokenization, and MinHash signatures.
- [scriptling.toon](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/toon.md): TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) encoding and decoding, a compact, human-readable alternative to JSON.
- [scriptling.wait_for](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/wait_for.md): Wait for files, directories, ports, HTTP endpoints, or processes to become available.
- [scriptling.xml](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities/xml.md): XML parsing and formatting (dict-based, string-only).
- [Utilities Libraries](https://scriptling.dev/okf/scriptling-libraries/utilities.md): General purpose utility libraries for Scriptling.
